metadata.title: Assessment Plan: sample-azure, SC-28 + SC-28(1) automated checks
metadata.remarks: Automated assessment of the infrastructure definition (main.bicep compiled to ARM JSON), not of the deployed resources. Each activity tests one rule from the datastore-checks component definition (Rule_Id prop) and names the objectives its result is evidence for; automation/result2oscal.py uses that mapping to turn OPA results into findings.

activities.title: Test encryption at rest
activities.description: Evaluate rule datastore_encrypted_at_rest against the datastore inventory produced from the infrastructure definition.

steps.title: Produce the datastore inventory
steps.description: Compile main.bicep to ARM JSON and run the Azure adapter (automation/azure_arm_inventory.py).

steps.title: Evaluate the check
steps.description: Evaluate data.datastores.encryption_at_rest.deny with OPA; every datastore must be absent from the deny set.

activities.title: Test tamper evidence
activities.description: Evaluate rule datastore_tamper_evident against the datastore inventory produced from the infrastructure definition.

steps.title: Produce the datastore inventory
steps.description: Compile main.bicep to ARM JSON and run the Azure adapter (automation/azure_arm_inventory.py).

steps.title: Evaluate the check
steps.description: Evaluate data.datastores.tamper_evidence.deny with OPA; every datastore must be absent from the deny set.

local-definitions.remarks: Not covered by this plan: verifying ledger digests on a deployed database, and examining key management. Those would be EXAMINE activities against the running system.

components.title: Open Policy Agent
components.description: OPA v1.22.4 (tools/opa.exe) evaluating the policies selected from policies/datastores by automation/oscal2policy.py.

components.title: Azure adapter
components.description: automation/azure_arm_inventory.py: maps ARM JSON (az bicep build output) to the datastore inventory (policies/schemas/datastore-inventory.schema.json).

tasks.title: Run the automated SC-28 checks
tasks.description: Run automation/run_assessment.py, which performs both activities and writes the assessment results.
